title: Multi-Agent Coordinated Method-Level Refactoring of Rust Code
abstract: arXiv:2611.29321v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As Rust codebases evolve, developers refactor code to reduce duplication, simplify complex methods, and keep related functionality together. Developers can make these changes manually or use IDE assists for supported operations, then check the resulting code with compiler diagnostics and tests. Method-level refactoring in Rust must preserve observable behavior while accounting for ownership, borrowing, and lifetimes. We present a large language model (LLM)-based workflow for extracting, inlining, and moving methods in Rust. The workflow combines candidate generation, configurable specialist review,and container-based validation. On six tasks from three open-source Rust projects, three end-to-end configurations passed all task checks on their first attempt, using 6, 13, and 31 model calls. To isolate the effect of review, we then gave four configurations the same six reference patches and six deliberately behavior-changing variants. A des

translated_title: 多智能体协同的 Rust 代码方法级重构
translated_abstract: 随着 Rust 代码库的演进，开发者会重构代码以减少重复、简化复杂方法，并将相关功能组织在一起。开发者可以手动进行这些更改，或使用 IDE 辅助完成受支持的操作，然后通过编译器诊断和测试来检查 resulting 代码。Rust 中的方法级重构必须在考虑所有权、借用和生命周期的同时保持可观察行为不变。我们提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的工作流，用于在 Rust 中提取、内联和移动方法。该工作流结合了候选生成、可配置的专家审查以及基于容器的验证。在来自三个开源 Rust 项目的六个任务上，三种端到端配置在首次尝试中即通过了所有任务检查，分别使用了 6、13 和 31 次模型调用。为了隔离审查环节的效果，我们随后给四种配置提供了相同的六个参考补丁和六个故意改变行为的变体。（注：原始摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的多智能体协同工作流，通过候选生成、可配置专家审查与容器化验证三个环节，安全地实现 Rust 代码的方法提取、内联与移动重构，并在开源项目任务上首次尝试即全部通过验证。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an LLM-based multi-agent workflow that combines candidate generation, configurable specialist review, and container-based validation to safely perform method-level extraction, inlining, and moving refactoring in Rust, with first-attempt success on open-source project tasks.
